page_title: MON 3-0 MAR | Monaco v Marseille 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' A player from Marseille commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Monaco win a free kick.
90+4' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) receives a quality pass inside the box and fires a first-time shot. His effort towards the left post is saved by the goalkeeper.

90+1' What an opportunity! Folarin Balogun (Monaco) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the right side of the goal, but Geronimo Rulli reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
90+1' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Monaco have been awarded a free kick.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) replacing Thilo Kehrer.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Amine Harit (Marseille) was quite harsh and Benoit Bastien didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monaco.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Breel Embolo departs the field of play to be replaced by George Ilenikhena (Monaco).
85' Adi Hutter decides to make a substitution. Lamine Camara will be replaced by Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco).
85' Amine Harit (Marseille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mason Greenwood.
82' 3 - 0 Goal! Denis Zakaria (Monaco) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Geronimo Rulli into the top right corner.
81' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is going to take the penalty!
80' Benoit Bastien interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Geronimo Rulli (Marseille). Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Monaco.
78' A corner kick by Monaco is thwarted by the well prepared Geronimo Rulli (Marseille).
78' Benoit Bastien shows a yellow card to Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) for his blatant foul.

77' Lamine Camara (Monaco) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the top right corner is, however superbly saved by Geronimo Rulli! The referee points to the corner flag and Monaco will take a corner.
76' It is time for a substitution. Pol Lirola is on for Ulisses Garcia (Marseille).

74' What a sensational goal that would have been! Amine Gouiri (Marseille) picks up the ball inside the box and fires a beautiful first-time shot, but it goes just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
72' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
70' Adi Hutter prepares a substitution. Mika Biereth is replaced by Folarin Balogun (Monaco).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) replaces Takumi Minamino.
69' Mika Biereth (Monaco) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.

67' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the top right corner, but Philipp Kohn was alert and made an amazing save! The ball goes behind for a corner. Marseille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

66' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Amar Dedic (Marseille), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
60' That's the end of the game for Jonathan Rowe, who is replaced by Amine Gouiri (Marseille).
60' Here is a change. Quentin Merlin is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Amar Dedic (Marseille).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) comes onto the pitch for Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg.
60' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Benoit Bastien signals that the goal stands! The Monaco players celebrate.
60' The Monaco players halt their celebrations as referee Benoit Bastien makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
58' 2 - 0 Breel Embolo (Monaco) latches onto a cross in the penalty area and fires the ball into the bottom right corner!

57' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the bottom right corner. Geronimo Rulli is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save.

56' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
54' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
53' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
53' Marseille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

52' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the left post is smartly dealt with by Philipp Kohn. The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
49' Breel Embolo (Monaco) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
49' The referee awards a corner and Lamine Camara (Monaco) goes over to take it.
48' Lamine Camara (Monaco) prepares to take a corner kick.
48' Mika Biereth (Monaco) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Monaco force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Marseille win a corner.
44' Marseille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
43' Luis Henrique (Marseille) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper. The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.

41' The Monaco players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.

39' Breel Embolo (Monaco) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benoit Bastien has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Marseille are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
38' Luis Henrique (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
37' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
36' Caio Henrique (Monaco) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
35' Decent spell from Marseille here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in.

34' 1 - 0 Goal! Denis Zakaria plays in Takumi Minamino (Monaco), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 1:0.
31' Monaco are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
30' Ball possession – 52:48.
27' Marseille are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.

23' What a poor attempt! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
22' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
21' Monaco are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
20' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes.

17' Mika Biereth (Monaco) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
15' One of the players from Monaco times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

13' Luis Henrique (Marseille) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
9' Benoit Bastien shows a yellow card to Wilfried Singo (Monaco) for a tough tackle.
6' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

4' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) takes a good touch to control a cross on the edge of the box and shoots towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block his effort.
3' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
2' Michael Murillo (Marseille) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Monaco will take the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
